1.explanation: We directly invoke the same aggregation logic Lighthouse uses. We provide two audits (one true/pass, one false/fail) each with equal weight. When calling Aggregate.aggregate(), the code should calculate a weighted average of 0.5, but due to the bug it currently reports 1.0. This reproduces the scenario seen in the UI where the parent aggregation displays a green pass despite a failed child audit.
1.bug_scenario: In the Lighthouse report UI, the “Accessibility” aggregation is showing as a green pass even though one of its sub‐audits (“Background and foreground colors have a sufficient contrast ratio”) has failed (red). In other words, when you feed one passing audit and one failing audit into an aggregation, the top–level score is still computed as 1 (pass) instead of the correct weighted average (<1).
